Rig Veda 10.17: TVASTAR prepares the bridal of his Daughter: all the world hears the tidings and assembles.
The Rishis of the Rig Veda
Rig Veda 10.184: MAY Visnu form and mould the womb, may Tvastar duly shape the forms
The Rishis of the Rig Veda
Niti 50: त्वं एव चातकाधारोऽ (Tvam eva chatakadharo)
Vairagya 51: त्वं राजा वयं (Tvam raja vayam)
Vairagya 52: अर्थानां ईशिषे त्वं (Arthanam ishishe tvam)
Amaru 23: त्वं मुग्धाक्षि विनैव कञ्चुलिकया (tvaṃ mugdhākṣi vinaiva kañculikayā)
